an image model.why: Studio generates images. With none of these set the module is live, billable and unable to produce anything, which is the one failure that reaches a paying customer.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.why: assertSupabaseEnv throws without it. The file this was copied from carried a fallback pointing at a DIFFERENT project, so a missing value would have written customer rows into the old platform's database.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.why: assertSupabaseEnv throws without it. Public by design - it is the browser key - but its absence stops the app at boot.

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.why: Server-side admin client. Bypasses row-level security, so it must never reach the browser and never appear in a NEXT_PUBLIC_ name.

STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.why: Every Stripe route answers 503 'Billing is not configured yet' when unset. The site is up and cannot take money.

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.why: Without it a payment succeeds at Stripe and the platform never hears about it - money taken, nothing delivered.

CRON_SECRET.why: cron-auth returns false when unset, so every scheduled job is rejected and nothing scheduled ever runs. No default, deliberately: the old 'omnex-cron-2026' value is in git history and any route accepting it is unauthenticated.

OMNEX_OWNER_KEY.why: isOwner refuses anything under 16 characters and fails closed when unset. Every owner-only route becomes unreachable rather than open, which is the right direction and an invisible one.

NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL.why: Falls back to the production URL in code. Wrong on a preview deploy rather than broken.

RESEND_API_KEY.why: Falls back to an empty string; email is skipped rather than failing.

RESEND_FROM_EMAIL.why: Has a default sender in code. Wrong on a deploy that owns a different domain, which is a deliverability problem rather than an outage.

OPENAI_API_KEY.why: One provider adapter among several. The router degrades to whichever providers are configured.

HF_TOKEN.why: Hugging Face adapter, and one of the image backends in the 'an image model' group.

FAL_KEY.why: Image generation backend; one of the 'an image model' group.

REPLICATE_API_TOKEN.why: Image generation backend; one of the 'an image model' group.

STABILITY_API_KEY.why: Image generation backend; one of the 'an image model' group.

COMFYUI_URL.why: Self-hosted image backend; one of the 'an image model' group. A URL, not a credential.

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.why: Model id override with a default in code.

GOOGLE_MODEL.why: Model id override with a default in code.

GROQ_MODEL.why: Model id override with a default in code.

OPENROUTER_MODEL.why: Model id override with a default in code.

HF_LLM_MODEL.why: Model id override with a default in code.

HF_EMBED_MODEL.why: Embedding model id override with a default in code.

OLLAMA_URL.why: Local inference host; unset means the adapter is simply not used.

OLLAMA_MODEL.why: Model id override for the local adapter.

OLLAMA_EMBED_URL.why: Local embedding host; unset means the adapter is not used.

OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL.why: Model id override for the local embedding adapter.

EMBED_DIM.why: Embedding width override. Changing it after vectors are stored invalidates the store, which is a migration rather than a setting.

LLM_CACHE_THRESHOLD.why: Cache similarity threshold with a default in code.
